edit.note: The take plays F F A E Bb Bb D/F F A G, not A F G E (score.md 'Generating' 3): the motif is played on a sampled note of the take's own piano (score.md's fallback) over the take slipped with its A on 110.0 and ducked 14 dB.

The loudest sustained region (26.0-27.1 s) ends on 148.8 (slip 121.7); 117.0-123.0 is the take's quiet opening, crossfaded over 1 s into the slipped take; a gain ride makes the level rise continuously to its peak at 149.0.
